correctness.rationale: Cao Theorem B supplies j_l:A_r→W_l, rotation by (−1)^lα with Diophantine rational independence, and invariant nowhere-vanishing holomorphic K3 2-form Ω. η=j_l*Ω invariant under dense cyclic phase rotation; by continuity under entire T² rotation group. Write η=h dz1∧dz2, the holomorphic g=z1 z2 h is rotation invariant on Reinhardt biannulus; Laurent coefficients except constant vanish, so η=c_l dz1/z1 ∧ dz2/z2 with c_l≠0. In log-radius-angle coordinates the normalized real volume form has density 4|c_l|² in ds1 dθ1 ds2 dθ2 (orientation convention fixed). Invariant log-radii under translation are almost surely constants for any ergodic supported μ; unique ergodicity of nonresonant torus translation forces Haar on that torus, conversely. Smooth conjugacy on compact modulus torus bounds all forward/backward derivative iterates, so every Lyapunov exponent zero and entropy zero for each such component. The canonical volume almost everywhere on the biannuli thus has zero positive-exponent contribution to Pesin integral; no conclusion about complement or global metric entropy. Infinite analytic proof, no finite extrapolation.
